gold_sql: SELECT su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.FLOOR) AS Total_Number_Of_Floors, sd.Total_Square_Footage, COUNT(DISTINCT su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Total_Number_Facility, COUNT(DISTINCT ssu.MIT_ID) AS Total_Supervisors, SUM(ssu.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) AS Total_Supervisees, SUM(fb.BUILDING_HEIGHT) AS Cumulative_Building_Height FROM (SELECT SPACE_DETAIL.*, SUM(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_COMPONENT) AS Total_Square_Footage FROM SPACE_DETAIL) sd JOIN FCLT_BUILDING fb ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY JOIN SPACE_FLOOR sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION) fo ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY su.DLC_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, sd.Total_Square_Footage;
gold_nlq: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
llm_nlq: For each DLC (show the DLC key and the name of the DLC), what are the total number of distinct floors, the total square footage (summed across all rooms within each building component), the total number of distinct facility organizations, the total number of distinct supervisors, the total number of supervisees, and the cumulative building height, considering only records where the DLC key matches the department name in the supervisor usage data?
llm_nlq_rev: For each DLC (show the DLC key and the name of the DLC), what are the total number of distinct floors, the total square footage (summed across all rooms within each building component), the total number of distinct facility organizations, the total number of distinct supervisors, the total number of supervisees, and the cumulative building height, considering only records where the DLC key matches the department name in the supervisor usage data?
gold_nlq_rev: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors (COUNT DISTINCT floors), total square footage (the SUM of square footage OVER (PARTITION BY building component)), total number of facility organizations (COUNT DISTINCT facility organizations), total number of supervisors (COUNT DISTINCT supervisors), total number of supervisees (SUM of supervisees), and total building heights (SUM of building heights) for each DLC, grouped by DLC key, name of the DLC, and that total square footage, joining building heights via SPACE_DETAIL.BUILDING_KEY = FCLT_BUILDING.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, floors via SPACE_DETAIL.FLOOR_KEY = SPACE_FLOOR.FLOOR_KEY, space units via SPACE_DETAIL.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, supervisors via SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES, and DLC names via FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY (using DISTINCT DLC_KEY and DLC_NAME from FCLT_ORGANIZATION)?
llm_nlq_rev_cross: For each DLC (show the DLC key and the name of the DLC), what are the total number of distinct floors, the total square footage (summed across all rooms within each building component), the total number of distinct facility organizations, the total number of distinct supervisors, the total number of supervisees, and the cumulative building height, considering only records where the DLC key matches the department name in the supervisor usage data?
llm_nlq_humanistic: For each DLC, can you show the DLC name and key along with the total number of floors, total square footage, number of facilities, number of supervisors, total supervisees, and the combined building height?
gold_rev_llm_nlq_mid_humanistic: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage, total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC, only counting cases where the DLC key matches the department name in the supervisor usage data?
gold_nlq_rev_v2: What is the DLC key, name of the DLC, total number of floors, total square footage (where the square footage is the sum of room square footage within each building component), total number of facility organizations, total number of supervisors, total number of supervisees, and total building heights for each DLC?
gold_nlq_verify_loop: For each department-level DLC, show the DLC key and the DLC name. Also report: the number of distinct floors associated with its spaces, the building-component total square footage where that square footage is defined as the sum of room square footage across all rooms in the same building component, the number of distinct facility organization keys, the number of distinct supervisors, the total number of supervisees, and the sum of building heights. The output should have one row for each DLC key and DLC name paired with each distinct building-component total square footage value.
